title: A jump table
description:
Rebuild the cases of a `switch` from a compiler's jump table.

```
cmp ecx, 4 / ja default / jump through table at 0x3000
table: 0x1040 0x1060 0x1040 0x1080 0x10A0
case 0, 2 -> 0x1040
case 1    -> 0x1060
case 3    -> 0x1080
case 4    -> 0x10A0
default   -> 0x10C0
```
hints: Compile a `switch` with five dense cases yourself and compare the table with your source.
requirements: The table holds 32-bit RVAs (or offsets from the image base, as MSVC does for x64).
Group case values that share a target.
Values above the bound go to the default.
stretch: Handle a `switch` whose cases start at 10: the code subtracts 10 first.
